correctness.rationale: The incidence convention gives a symmetric orthogonal projection, and vertex exchanges establish connectivity for n>=7. Permuting ground-set labels is edge-transitive and only permutes or changes signs of edge coordinates, so the endpoint norms equal the absolute sum in one column. I reconstructed the dipole by solving an independent radial one-pole Laplacian system: for overlap k with the pole, the number of neighbors of overlap j is binom(3-k,j) binom(n-6+k,3-j); subtract the two pole solutions to obtain the dipole. This reproduces all four orbit potentials. Their sign ordering follows from the positive quadratic separation and the positive coefficients after shifting n by 8. Counting disjoint pairs between distinct ordered potential levels gives the displayed cut rational function, including automatically zero multiplicities for absent levels; at n=7 a separate full graph reconstruction gives TV=116/35. The trace makes every diagonal 2(N-1)/(Nd) in (0,1), so the cycle correction is exactly 1-4(N-1)/(Nd). Independent symbolic subtraction and shifting n by 9 give positive coefficients; exact comparisons of n=7,8,9 prove the unique distinct maxima, and expansion confirms both coefficients through order n^-2. Replay: python3 /workspace/review-checks.py (SymPy; section kneser). This is a mathematical and computational review, not proof-assistant validation.
